meta.title: Fix chunk test failures on CI/CD environments
meta.body_summary: Adjust CI-specific test parameters (HTTP timeout, loop counts, chunk interval, cleanup wait) to prevent timeouts and computation failures in chunk tests.

core_change_summary.description: Adjust CI-specific parameters: HTTP agent timeout from 5 to 20 min, computation loops halved from 20M/1M to 10M/0.5M, chunk interval reduced from 14M to 7M iterations, and global state cleanup max wait power increased from 8 to 10 for CI.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes are one-liner parameter tweaks; no new files.
change_trajectory: Single commit implementing all four CI parameter adjustments.
